name: watch-everywhere
description: watchEverywhere - 基于规则的多源聚合阅读 / 观看工具（参考 any-reader 实现）

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @watch-everywhere/server" "npm run dev -w @watch-everywhere/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @watch-everywhere/core && npm run test -w @watch-everywhere/server
